hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: GlueHook implements a SHIELD that intercepts MAIN→SECONDARY sells and fills them from a reserve pot at the pool's exact price (via beforeSwap delta return), preventing price impact. On SECONDARY→MAIN buys, an afterSwap PUMP uses pot reserves to buy back main tokens and deliver them to buyers. Auto-compounds an LP program via fee harvesting in afterSwap.
